# Metrix — 角色分工与执行规则

Metrix 是独立子项目。根目录 `CLAUDE.md`(Mythos 宪章 v2.0)第 1 节与第 3.7 节不适用于 Metrix;第 5 节「不要做」继续适用。在 `metrix/` 内,本文件与宪章冲突时以本文件为准。

本文件的修改须经 Review Gate 裁决、Project Owner 批准,并记录原因与时间。

## 1. 角色

| 角色 | 由谁担任 | 职责 | 不做 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Project Owner | Miyaji | 拍板重大事项;批准租卡与预算;在 Review Gate 与 Claude Code 之间转达 | 日常审查、代码细节 |
| Review Gate(总管) | claude.ai Project「Metrix」 | 总体设计、协议审阅、Gate 裁决、下达编号指令、维护决定记录 | 写代码、跑命令、替 Owner 拍板 |
| Executor | Claude Code 主会话 | 写代码、运行、提交、写 SUBMISSION_NOTE、调用两个审查 subagent | 改协议、审查自己的产物、推翻审查结论 |
| Code Reviewer | subagent `code-reviewer` | 查 bug、死代码、可读性、合理性、与协议的一致性 | 修改任何文件 |
| Data Auditor | subagent `data-auditor` | 用自写脚本独立复算哈希、L1–L6 泄漏、候选可行性、split | 复用 Executor 的检查代码、加载模型权重 |

重大事项(只有 Owner 能批准):研究方向、模型、arm 结构、门槛数值、PROTOCOL_FROZEN、TEST 评测时机、租用 GPU、冻结后的协议改动、删除文件、改写 Git 历史。

## 2. 当前阶段

- E1 Pilot,状态:PROTOCOL_FROZEN（v1.1）（出处：Review Gate 第 8 轮裁决，Owner 批准，2026-11-22 09:44 UTC；作用范围：本阶段（Owner 在第 9 轮答复，见 metrix/e1-pilot/tasks/ROUND9_TASKS.md 第二段）；原因：协议已冻结并发布 v1.1 勘误版，原状态未随冻结更新，见 metrix/e1-pilot/reports/ROUND8_REPORT.md「待 Review Gate 决定」第 9 项）
- 分支:metrix-e1-pilot-protocol-v1
- 基线:leotree2020/OpenMythos mythos-idea-thermo-v1 @ 61d3c76705b28cc2ee334abc5bf1baaac4fc30dc
- 模型:Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B @ 70d244cc86ccca08cf5af4e1e306ecf908b1ad5e
- 工作目录:metrix/e1-pilot/。metrix/ 以外只允许:根目录 CLAUDE.md 第 6 节、.claude/agents/ 下的两个 subagent 文件。

## 3. 硬性禁止(收到 PROTOCOL_FROZEN 之前)

- 不训练、不评测、不生成或读取 TEST 数据。
- 不在 CPU 环境加载真实模型权重。CPU 只做模板、tokenizer、哈希、泄漏检查,以及用随机初始化的同构小模型做冒烟测试。
- 汇报时写明实际运行环境(主机名或环境类型),不要笼统称为「本地」。

## 4. 算力

- 训练与评测只在单张 A100 80GB 上执行,上限 4 小时。首次运行记录设备全名,同一次 Pilot 内必须一致,否则整批作废。
- 环境、下载、冒烟测试先在 CPU 环境完成;租卡后只跑正式流程。预检预估总时长超过 3.5 小时即停（协议 ST11）；累计 GPU 时间超过 4 小时即停（协议 ST7）。（出处：Review Gate 第 8 轮裁决，Owner 批准，2026-11-22 09:44 UTC；作用范围：本阶段；只替换本条原末句「实测预计超过 3 小时即停下报告。」，本节其余文字不变（作用范围与替换范围均为 Owner 在第 9 轮答复，见 metrix/e1-pilot/tasks/ROUND9_TASKS.md 第二段）；原因：原 3 小时与协议 ST11 的 3.5 小时不一致，见 metrix/e1-pilot/reports/ROUND8_REPORT.md「待 Review Gate 决定」第 6 项）

## 5. 自动审查循环

1. 每次提交前调用 `code-reviewer`。
2. 改动涉及数据、split、候选集、打分或评测代码时,再调用 `data-auditor`。
3. 任一结论为 BLOCK:修复后重新调用。不得跳过审查,不得改写或摘要替代审查原文。
4. 连续 3 轮未 PASS:停止,提交当前状态与全部审查原始输出,等待 Review Gate。
5. 审查原始输出保存到 `metrix/e1-pilot/reviews/<commit-hash>/`,随提交推送。
6. 每次调用审查 subagent,调用文字的第一句固定为:「先读仓库中的 .claude/agents/<名称>.md，以它为你的完整定义；它与你已加载的定义冲突时，以仓库文件为准。」调用前比对仓库文件与已加载定义的 frontmatter;两个版本的 tools 行不一致时必须停下,不得用此方法替代。（出处：Review Gate 第 7 轮裁决，Owner 批准，本阶段，2026-11-22 03:25:59 UTC）

## 6. PR 审查

- 改动经 PR 合入,不直接推送到受保护分支。
- PR 自动审查与本地 subagent 结论不一致时,以更严格的一方为准,并在 PR 中说明。

## 7. 必须等待人工指令的事项

PROTOCOL_FROZEN 的发出与修改、租用 GPU、生成或评测 TEST、删除任何文件、改写 Git 历史、force push。

注：「删除任何文件」不含会话临时目录；但支撑结论的输出须先提交。

## 8. 冲突处理

- Reviewer / Auditor 与 Executor 意见不同:由 Review Gate 裁决。
- 协议未覆盖的情况:停止并报告,由 Review Gate 提出方案。
- Review Gate 的裁决写入决定记录时须注明作用范围:本次提交 / 本阶段 / 永久。「永久」与「本阶段」的裁决可写入本文件,写入时须注明作用范围;「本阶段」的裁决在本阶段结束时失效。（出处：Review Gate 第 7 轮裁决（第 8 轮指令第 1e 项），Owner 批准，2026-11-22 05:27 UTC；原因：原文只允许「永久」的裁决写入本文件，与已写入的第 5 节第 6 条、第 10 节的「本阶段」裁决矛盾，见 metrix/e1-pilot/reports/ROUND7_REPORT.md「待 Review Gate 决定」第 4 项）（作用范围：永久。出处：Review Gate 第 8 轮裁决，Owner 批准，2026-11-22 09:44 UTC；原因：1e 写入时未注明这条裁决自己的作用范围，见 metrix/e1-pilot/reports/ROUND8_REPORT.md「待 Review Gate 决定」第 1 项）

## 9. 汇报格式

- commit hash 与报告路径。
- 两份审查的原始输出路径与结论。
- 所有结论附原始命令输出。自检勾选不算证据。
- 原始输出一律写入仓库并推送，不留在临时目录；data-auditor 须提交 audit 脚本的完整 stdout。（出处：Review Gate 第 4 轮裁决，Owner 批准，永久）

## 10. 信任状态

- `code-reviewer`:已验证（2026-11-21 盲测 3/3 检出、0 误报；每类仅 1 个样本，PASS 仍须附原始输出）。
- `data-auditor`:「待验证」。2026-11-21 的盲测只测了 code-reviewer;埋入已知 bug 的检出率测试通过前,其 PASS 仅作参考。
- 以上两条的出处：Review Gate 第 5 轮裁决。（出处：Review Gate 第 6 轮裁决，Owner 批准，本阶段，2026-11-22 03:25:59 UTC）

- 环境、下载、冒烟测试先在 CPU 环境完成;租卡后只跑正式流程。预检预估总时长超过 3.5 小时即停（协议 ST11）；累计 GPU 时间超过 4 小时即停（协议 ST7）。（出处：Review Gate 第 8 轮裁决，Owner 批准，2026-11-22 09:44 UTC；作用范围：本阶段；只替换本条原末句「实测预计超过 3 小时即停下报告。」，本节其余文字不变（作用范围与替换范围均为 Owner 在第 9 轮答复，见 metrix/e1-pilot/tasks/ROUND9_TASKS.md 第二段）；原因：原 3 小时与协议 ST11 的 3.5 小时不一致，见 metrix/e1-pilot/reports/ROUND8_REPORT.md「待 Review Gate 决定」第 6 项）

## 5. 自动审查循环

1. 每次提交前调用 `code-reviewer`。
2. 改动涉及数据、split、候选集、打分或评测代码时,再调用 `data-auditor`。
3. 任一结论为 BLOCK:修复后重新调用。不得跳过审查,不得改写或摘要替代审查原文。
4. 连续 3 轮未 PASS:停止,提交当前状态与全部审查原始输出,等待 Review Gate。
5. 审查原始输出保存到 `metrix/e1-pilot/reviews/<commit-hash>/`,随提交推送。
6. 每次调用审查 subagent,调用文字的第一句固定为:「先读仓库中的 .claude/agents/<名称>.md，以它为你的完整定义；它与你已加载的定义冲突时，以仓库文件为准。」调用前比对仓库文件与已加载定义的 frontmatter;两个版本的 tools 行不一致时必须停下,不得用此方法替代。（出处：Review Gate 第 7 轮裁决，Owner 批准，本阶段，2026-11-22 03:25:59 UTC）

## 6. PR 审查

- 改动经 PR 合入,不直接推送到受保护分支。
- PR 自动审查与本地 subagent 结论不一致时,以更严格的一方为准,并在 PR 中说明。

## 7. 必须等待人工指令的事项

PROTOCOL_FROZEN 的发出与修改、租用 GPU、生成或评测 TEST、删除任何文件、改写 Git 历史、force push。

注：「删除任何文件」不含会话临时目录；但支撑结论的输出须先提交。

## 8. 冲突处理

- Reviewer / Auditor 与 Executor 意见不同:由 Review Gate 裁决。
- 协议未覆盖的情况:停止并报告,由 Review Gate 提出方案。
- Review Gate 的裁决写入决定记录时须注明作用范围:本次提交 / 本阶段 / 永久。「永久」与「本阶段」的裁决可写入本文件,写入时须注明作用范围;「本阶段」的裁决在本阶段结束时失效。（出处：Review Gate 第 7 轮裁决（第 8 轮指令第 1e 项），Owner 批准，2026-11-22 05:27 UTC；原因：原文只允许「永久」的裁决写入本文件，与已写入的第 5 节第 6 条、第 10 节的「本阶段」裁决矛盾，见 metrix/e1-pilot/reports/ROUND7_REPORT.md「待 Review Gate 决定」第 4 项）（作用范围：永久。出处：Review Gate 第 8 轮裁决，Owner 批准，2026-11-22 09:44 UTC；原因：1e 写入时未注明这条裁决自己的作用范围，见 metrix/e1-pilot/reports/ROUND8_REPORT.md「待 Review Gate 决定」第 1 项）

"""ic11_04 (implementation stage C, C4 code commit, round 1; task 1 of the invocation): ST11's estimate (Review Gate ruling
of 2026-11-27, tasks/IMPL_C4_RULING.md item 1: ST11 reads B17's estimate + the checkpoint overhead, stop above 3.5 h)
recomputed by me from the smoke's step 2 record (<smoke>/records/step2_record.json: the measured per-step seconds,
fact_tokens_per_step, anchor_tokens_per_step, the timing block) and counts I read from the frozen protocol text
(sections 7, 8, 10, 11; git cat-file at the frozen commit) and the frozen SPLIT_MANIFEST.json / SEARCH_SPACE.json.
Smoke values (CPU, random small model): no conclusion about the A100 run.

My model (my own formula, written from the protocol and the revised B17 text; nothing of the Executor imported):
  runs (section 7): F, L, A x 6 configs at the search seed (18) + F, L, A x the 2 other seeds (6) + S, Y x 3 seeds (6)
    = 30; arm A runs = 6 + 2 = 8, other runs 22; steps per run 300 (section 7 table "共 300 步"; Y also 300).
  mean step seconds = mean of the recorded seconds_per_step without the first (warm-up).
  A factor = 1 + (forward + train coefficient) x anchor tokens per step / (train coefficient x fact tokens per step),
    coefficients from section 10 (training 6 P T, forward 2 P T).
  evaluation units: DEV: N (step 3) + 30 runs + 3 G0.8 re-evaluations (section 8 G0.8: the 3 checkpoints of F's
    selected configuration evaluated twice); TEST: N + 15 final checkpoints (F, L, A, S, Y x 3 seeds), each x TEST/DEV
    questions per fact (frozen templates per relation).
  B17 = (mean_step x 300 x (22 + 8 x A factor) + units x dev_evaluation_seconds + GPU seconds already used) / 3600;
    GPU seconds already used = 0 in the smoke (CPU; the smoke's work directory has no device ledger).
  checkpoint overhead (revised B17 text) = 32 x load (N, the 30 runs, N at TEST) + 30 x (2 x hash + save + reload +
    file hash) + 18 x reload (3 G0.8 + 15 TEST checkpoints) + 17 x hash (16 TEST models + N once more) + 15 x file hash.
  ST11 estimate = B17 + overhead / 3600; ST11 triggers iff estimate > 3.5 (bound from the ST11 row); the smoke records
    "within bound" or "smoke: would stop".
usage: python -I -B ic11_04_st11.py <repo_root> <smoke_work_dir>"""
import os
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import json
import re
from collections import Counter
from ia_common import frozen_json, frozen_protocol, run

TOL = 1e-9


def close(a, b):
    return abs(a - b) <= TOL * max(1.0, abs(a), abs(b))


def one(pattern, text, what):
    m = re.findall(pattern, text)
    print("  protocol %-44s %r -> %s" % (what, pattern, m))
    if len(m) != 1:
        raise ValueError("%s: %d matches" % (what, len(m)))
    return m[0]


def main():
    repo, work = sys.argv[1:3]
    ok = True
    prot = frozen_protocol(repo)
    ss = frozen_json(repo, "SEARCH_SPACE.json")
    sm = frozen_json(repo, "SPLIT_MANIFEST.json")
    print("== counts read from the frozen protocol (commit 87a244db)")
    per_arm, search_total = [int(x) for x in one(r"F、L、A 各 \*\*(\d+)\*\* 个配置,共 \*\*(\d+)\*\* 次搜索训练", prot, "search")]
    other_seeds = one(r"F、L、A 用种子 ([\d、]+) 各再训练一次", prot, "extra seeds F, L, A").split("、")
    sy_seeds = int(one(r"S、Y 各训练 (\d+) 个种子", prot, "S, Y seeds"))

`-p ic11_06_plugin` while tests/test_run_pilot.py::test_formal_st11_reads_b17_plus_the_checkpoint_overhead[...] runs as a
driver subprocess (C1 ruling item 5). It checks nothing; it appends to the JSONL file named by IC11_TRACE one line per
call of the observed functions, with arguments and results passed through unchanged:
  metrix_e1.pilot.run_gate (its return value, or the exception type and message; the Pilot's root and work directory),
  metrix_e1.pilot.st11_estimate_hours (arguments and result), metrix_e1.stops.st11 (its estimate argument, the bound
  of the contract it was given, and whether it raised: the stop code, status and message), metrix_e1.pilot.step3 is
  not wrapped (the test replaces it). The wrappers are installed after collection, before the test's own
  monkeypatching (which replaces CP.estimate_total_hours, P.checkpoint_overhead_seconds, P.step3 and T.train_run, none
  of which is wrapped here)."""
import json
import os

TRACE = os.environ.get("IC11_TRACE")
_S = {"installed": False, "node": None}


def _log(ev):
    with open(TRACE, "a", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        fh.write(json.dumps(dict(ev, node=_S["node"]), default=repr) + "\n")


def pytest_collection_finish(session):
    if _S["installed"]:
        return
    import metrix_e1.pilot as P
    import metrix_e1.stops as STP
    orig_gate, orig_sum, orig_st11 = P.run_gate, P.st11_estimate_hours, STP.st11

    def run_gate(p, *a, **k):
        _log({"call": "run_gate", "args": [repr(x) for x in a], "root": str(getattr(p, "root", None)),
              "work": str(getattr(p, "work", None))})
        try:
            r = orig_gate(p, *a, **k)
        except BaseException as e:
            _log({"call": "run_gate", "raised": type(e).__name__, "message": str(e)})
            raise
        _log({"call": "run_gate", "returned": r})
        return r

    def st11_estimate_hours(b17_hours, overhead_seconds):
        r = orig_sum(b17_hours, overhead_seconds)
        _log({"call": "st11_estimate_hours", "b17_hours": b17_hours, "overhead_seconds": overhead_seconds, "result": r,
              "result_repr": repr(r)})
        return r

    def st11(fz, contract, estimate_hours):
        ev = {"call": "stops.st11", "estimate_hours": estimate_hours, "estimate_repr": repr(estimate_hours),
              "bound": contract.stops.st11_hours}
        try:
            r = orig_st11(fz, contract, estimate_hours)
        except BaseException as e:
            _log(dict(ev, raised=type(e).__name__, stop=getattr(e, "stop", None), status=getattr(e, "status", None),
                      message=str(e)))
            raise
        _log(dict(ev, returned=r))
        return r
    P.run_gate, P.st11_estimate_hours, STP.st11 = run_gate, st11_estimate_hours, st11
    _S["installed"] = True


def pytest_runtest_setup(item):
    _S["node"] = item.nodeid
    _log({"event": "setup"})

"""ic11_06 (implementation stage C, C4 code commit, round 1; task 3 of the invocation): the Executor's test
tests/test_run_pilot.py::test_formal_st11_reads_b17_plus_the_checkpoint_overhead[<param>] run once as a driver (C1 ruling
item 5; one parameter per invocation of this script), with my pass-through plugin ic11_06_plugin.py, pytest's
--basetemp under my scratch directory (so that the test's clone and bare remote stay for my inspection). My own
reading afterwards uses git commands only (nothing of the Executor imported).

The test (as staged): formal on a clone with a bare remote, the real preflight with train_run at 1 smoke step,
CP.estimate_total_hours replaced to give 3.0 h (its parts real), P.checkpoint_overhead_seconds replaced to give 1801 s
(sum_over_bound) or 1800 s (sum_at_bound) with the real counts, P.step3 replaced by a RuntimeError("injected after
step 2"); the real st11_estimate_hours and stops.st11.

My expectations (printed before the run; derived from my reading of the protocol (ST11: stop above 3.5 h, BLOCKED per
B16 / ST11 row "停止;报告 Owner") and of the code paths: stop_in_step commits the step record with "stopped" then
re-raises; run_gate turns a stop into (False, status) and an exception into the experiment record and re-raises):
  sum_over_bound: estimate 3.0 + 1801/3600 = 3.50027... > 3.5 -> ST11 raised (Stop ST11 BLOCKED, message
    "preflight estimate 3.500 h > 3.5 h"); run_gate returns (False, "BLOCKED"); remote: step 2 record with
    stopped {code ST11, status BLOCKED}, no step 3 record, experiment record Status BLOCKED with stop code ST11.
  sum_at_bound: estimate 3.0 + 1800/3600 = 3.5 exactly (0.5 is exact in binary) -> not above the bound, no stop;
    run_gate raises RuntimeError("injected after step 2"); remote: step 2 record without "stopped", st11 "within bound",
    no step 3 record, experiment record Status NOT_TESTED with the injected message.
  both: st11_estimate_hours called once with (3.0, overhead); stops.st11 called once with that value and bound 3.5;
    the clone clean and at the remote's main; pytest "1 passed", exit 0; this repository unchanged.
usage: python -I -B ic11_06_st11_tests.py <repo_root> <venv_python> <inputs_dir> <scratch_dir (created, must not exist)>
       <sum_over_bound|sum_at_bound>"""
import os
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import glob
import json
import shlex
import subprocess
from ia_common import run

NODE = "metrix/e1-pilot/tests/test_run_pilot.py::test_formal_st11_reads_b17_plus_the_checkpoint_overhead[%s]"
RES = "metrix/e1-pilot/results"


def git(d, *args):
    r = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(d), *args], capture_output=True, text=True, env=dict(os.environ, GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS="0"))
    return r.stdout, r.returncode


def main():
    repo, py, inputs, scratch, param = sys.argv[1:6]
    if param not in ("sum_over_bound", "sum_at_bound") or os.path.exists(scratch):
        print("bad parameter or scratch dir %s exists: refused" % scratch)
        return False
    os.makedirs(scratch)
    over = param == "sum_over_bound"
    overhead = 1801.0 if over else 1800.0
    est = 3.0 + overhead / 3600.0
    exp = {"estimate": est, "st11_triggers": est > 3.5, "run_gate": ("returns [False, 'BLOCKED']" if over else
                                                                  "raises RuntimeError('injected after step 2')"),
           "step2_stopped": {"code": "ST11", "status": "BLOCKED"} if over else None,
           "step2_st11_field": None if over else "within bound",
           "stop_message_contains": "preflight estimate %.3f h > 3.5 h" % est if over else None,
           "experiment_status": "BLOCKED" if over else "NOT_TESTED", "experiment_stop_code": "ST11" if over else None,
           "step3_record": False}
    print("== my expectation for [%s] (before the run)" % param)
    print(json.dumps(exp, indent=1, sort_keys=True))
    print("   estimate repr %r; > 3.5: %s" % (est, est > 3.5))
    sys.stdout.flush()

    trace = os.path.join(scratch, "trace.jsonl")
    open(trace, "w").close()
    st_args = ("status", "--porcelain", "--ignored", "--untracked-files=all", "--", "metrix", ":(exclude)metrix/e1-pilot/audit")
    gs0, ix0 = git(repo, *st_args)[0], git(repo, "ls-files", "-s")[0]
    head0 = git(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD")[0]
    env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH=os.path.join(repo, "metrix/e1-pilot/src") + os.pathsep + os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)),
               METRIX_INPUTS_DIR=inputs, IC11_TRACE=trace, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1", GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS="0")
    base = os.path.join(scratch, "basetemp")
    cmd = [py, "-B", "-m", "pytest", "-q", "-p", "no:cacheprovider", "-p", "ic11_06_plugin", "-rA", "--basetemp=%s" % base,
           NODE % param]
    print("\n$ (cwd %s) PYTHONPATH=%s %s" % (repo, env["PYTHONPATH"], " ".join(shlex.quote(c) for c in cmd)))
    print("----- pytest stdout+stderr begin -----")
    sys.stdout.flush()
    r = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=repo, env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True)
    print(r.stdout.rstrip("\n"))
    print("----- pytest stdout+stderr end ----- exit %d" % r.returncode)
    ok = r.returncode == 0 and r.stdout.strip().split("\n")[-1].startswith("1 passed")

    print("\n== trace (my plugin)")
    ev = [json.loads(x) for x in open(trace, encoding="utf-8").read().split("\n") if x]
    for e in ev:
        print("  %s" % json.dumps(e, sort_keys=True))
    sums = [e for e in ev if e.get("call") == "st11_estimate_hours"]
    st11 = [e for e in ev if e.get("call") == "stops.st11"]
    gate = [e for e in ev if e.get("call") == "run_gate" and ("returned" in e or "raised" in e)]
    root = [e["root"] for e in ev if e.get("call") == "run_gate" and "root" in e]
    print("  st11_estimate_hours calls %d, args/result %s | expected one call (3.0, %r) -> %r" % (
        len(sums), [(e["b17_hours"], e["overhead_seconds"], e["result_repr"]) for e in sums], overhead, est))
    ok &= len(sums) == 1 and sums[0]["b17_hours"] == 3.0 and sums[0]["overhead_seconds"] == overhead and sums[0]["result"] == est
    print("  stops.st11 calls %d: %s" % (len(st11), [(e["estimate_repr"], e["bound"], e.get("raised"), e.get("stop"),
                                                     e.get("status"), e.get("message")) for e in st11]))
    ok &= len(st11) == 1 and st11[0]["estimate_hours"] == est and st11[0]["bound"] == 3.5
    if over:
        ok &= st11[0].get("raised") == "Stop" and st11[0].get("stop") == "ST11" and st11[0].get("status") == "BLOCKED" \
            and exp["stop_message_contains"] in st11[0].get("message", "")
    else:
        ok &= "raised" not in st11[0]
    print("  run_gate outcome %s" % gate)
    if over:
        ok &= len(gate) == 1 and gate[0].get("returned") == [False, "BLOCKED"]
    else:
        ok &= len(gate) == 1 and gate[0].get("raised") == "RuntimeError" and gate[0].get("message") == "injected after step 2"

    print("\n== the test's bare remote and clone (my git reading)")
    remotes = glob.glob(os.path.join(base, "*", "remote.git"))
    print("  bare remotes under basetemp: %s" % remotes)
    if len(remotes) != 1 or len(root) != 1:
        print("  cannot locate exactly one remote and one clone")
        return False
    remote, clone = remotes[0], root[0]
    log = git(remote, "log", "--format=%h %s", "--name-status", "main")[0]
    print("  git log --name-status main (remote):\n" + "\n".join("    " + x for x in log.rstrip("\n").split("\n")))
    tree = git(remote, "ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", "main")[0].split("\n")
    res = sorted(x for x in tree if x.startswith(RES + "/"))
    print("  files under %s at the remote's main: %s" % (RES, res))
    has3 = RES + "/step3_record.json" in tree
    s2 = json.loads(git(remote, "show", "main:%s/step2_record.json" % RES)[0])
    pre = s2["preflight"]
    mine = pre["b17_estimate_hours"] + pre["checkpoint_overhead"]["seconds"] / 3600.0
    print("  step2 record: b17_estimate_hours %r | checkpoint_overhead.seconds %r | st11_estimate_hours %r (my sum %r, equal "
          "%s) | st11_bound_hours %r | st11 %r | st11_reads %r | stopped %s" % (
              pre["b17_estimate_hours"], pre["checkpoint_overhead"]["seconds"], pre["st11_estimate_hours"], mine,
              mine == pre["st11_estimate_hours"], pre["st11_bound_hours"], pre.get("st11"), pre.get("st11_reads"),
              s2.get("stopped")))
    ok &= pre["b17_estimate_hours"] == 3.0 and pre["checkpoint_overhead"]["seconds"] == overhead
    ok &= mine == pre["st11_estimate_hours"] == est and pre["st11_bound_hours"] == 3.5
    print("  checkpoint_overhead.counts %s" % json.dumps(pre["checkpoint_overhead"]["counts"], sort_keys=True))
    ok &= pre["checkpoint_overhead"]["counts"] == {"base_loads": 32, "checkpoints": 30, "checkpoint_reloads": 18,
                                                   "test_state_hashes": 17, "test_file_hashes": 15, "test_models": 16}
    if over:
        st = s2.get("stopped") or {}
        ok &= st.get("code") == "ST11" and st.get("status") == "BLOCKED" and exp["stop_message_contains"] in st.get("message", "")
    else:
        ok &= "stopped" not in s2 and pre.get("st11") == "within bound"
    exps = [x for x in tree if x.startswith(RES + "/experiment_record_formal_") and x.endswith(".json")]
    print("  experiment records (json) %s | step3 record present %s" % (exps, has3))
    ok &= len(exps) == 1 and not has3
    if len(exps) == 1:
        rec = json.loads(git(remote, "show", "main:%s" % exps[0])[0])
        tpl = rec["template"]
        sc = tpl["Stop Conditions"]
        print("  experiment record Status %r | Stop Conditions stop %s" % (tpl["Status"], json.dumps(sc.get("stop"), ensure_ascii=False)))
        ok &= tpl["Status"] == exp["experiment_status"]
        if over:
            ok &= (sc.get("stop") or {}).get("code") == "ST11"
        else:
            ok &= "injected after step 2" in json.dumps(sc.get("stop"))
    porc = git(clone, "status", "--porcelain")[0]
    ch, rh = git(clone, "rev-parse", "HEAD")[0].strip(), git(remote, "rev-parse", "main")[0].strip()
    print("  clone %s: status --porcelain %r | HEAD %s == remote main %s: %s" % (clone, porc, ch[:12], rh[:12], ch == rh))
    ok &= porc == "" and ch == rh

    gs1, ix1 = git(repo, *st_args)[0], git(repo, "ls-files", "-s")[0]
    print("\nthis repository unchanged (git status audit/ excluded, index, HEAD): %s %s %s" % (
        gs1 == gs0, ix1 == ix0, git(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD")[0] == head0))
    ok &= gs1 == gs0 and ix1 == ix0 and git(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD")[0] == head0
    return bool(ok)


run(main)
